describes: prefetch() is replaced wholesale by its failure value -- every hover hint is refused. The suite MUST redden, or nothing observes the hover/idle warm path at all
a no-op statement at the top of prefetch() -- the suite MUST stay green

hydrateFromCache's bare `return`: a DISABLED cache is hydrated anyway. The try/catch below swallows whatever a disabled cache throws, so the only thing standing between 'cache off' and a call into it is this one line
prefetch producer 1: the empty-id guard goes, so a hover over a row with no id yet fires GET /sessions//messages

prefetch producer 2: the already-warm guard goes, so hovering a session whose turns are already in the store spends a request re-fetching them. warm() re-checks before writing, so the STORE is unchanged and the outgoing request is the only observable

prefetch producer 3: the in-flight guard goes, so two hover events over the same COLD row in one tick each start a request. Distinct from P2 -- nothing is in the store yet, so the already-warm guard cannot refuse either of them

producer 3 inverted: the guard stays but the release goes, so a session prefetched once can never be prefetched again -- a warm that FAILED leaves the row permanently unwarmable and the hover silently stops working. P3 shows the guard fires; only this shows it stops firing
